title: A completed integral local reduction loses at most one lower degree
statement: Let l be prime and E/Q_l a finite extension with integral coefficient datum d [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For schemes g:Y→X and the actual inverse-image completed ring g⁻¹B_X [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], let L be a cochain complex of g⁻¹B_X-modules whose terms below a vanish. For every quotient index n≥0, its derived scalar extension to g⁻¹R_n has zero cohomology in all degrees q<a−1. No identification of g⁻¹B_X with the completed coefficient ring newly formed on Y is assumed.

proof.text: Over the lifted valuation ring A, multiplication by the nonzero uniformizer power varpi^(n+1) and the ordinary quotient map give a short exact sequence A→A→A/(varpi^(n+1)). Exact constant sheafification followed by the flat completed coefficient extension preserves this sequence. The finite-coefficient comparison identifies the last object with Res(R_n). The section computation of the finite-reduction map shows that its quotient map sends 1 to 1. This is the private completed_principal_resolution, generalized from the existing completed quotient calculation to the lifted integral datum.

Apply exact pro-etale inverse image along g. The unit and coefficient-restriction inverse-image isomorphisms identify the three objects with the regular inverse-image completed module, itself, and the restricted inverse-image quotient. Their section formulas and naturality of the coefficient adjunction unit identify the transported quotient with the coefficient ring map, which sends 1 to 1. Exactness is retained.

Apply the normalized scalar-extension triangle to Q(L). Since Q(L) is bounded below by a, the outer terms H^q(L) and H^(q+1)(L) in the long exact cohomology sequence vanish whenever q<a−1. The restricted reduced cohomology is therefore zero. Exact scalar restriction commutes with cohomology and has the same underlying abelian sheaf. Faithful forgetting reflects zero, giving the claimed bound. The argument includes the zero complex and empty scheme.

theorem integralLocalReduction_isGE
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (L : CochainComplex (pbcModules Y
      ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj (pbcAdicCompletion X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)))) ℤ)
    (a : ℤ) [L.IsStrictlyGE a] (n : ℕ) :
    (adicTowerLocalReduction (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g L n).IsGE (a - 1)
